title: Preserve reviewed unique source from amber-flame-tiger-sand
body:
## Scope

Review-only archive of screened, distinct source code and public text from [collink1007/amber-flame-tiger-sand](https://github.com/collink1007/amber-flame-tiger-sand), source main `781f30a966672ab9bd8a2680e6c661ffa83d2610`.

- Adds 65 unique blobs plus a path/hash manifest and archive note.
- Omits byte-identical content already present anywhere in Grok-ready.
- Does not modify or delete existing files and is not wired into the running app.
- One small source-only test blob was withheld after a static credential-pattern match; no value or path is reproduced here.
- Data/attachments, generated output, screenshots, binary media, PDFs, ZIP archives, and root build/environment manifests are excluded pending separate review.
- This is not a migration-completeness sign-off and does not authorize deletion of any source repository.

The source repository does not declare a license; this PR preserves the repository URL and exact source commit for attribution.

title: Preserve approved ZIP as byte-exact chunks
body:
## What this adds

- Preserves the approved ZIP as an opaque, byte-exact archive; it is not unpacked.
- Stores 46 Git blobs under 100644 entries, plus a manifest, README, and Python reassembly/check script.
- The manifest records the expected total size (189865723 bytes) and SHA-256 (4c9f2237513112101cbdee35415eee89c97dae6c4f7c20405186729dc3ad22b6).
- The script checks each chunk and the reconstructed archive before publishing its output file.

This PR only preserves this approved archive. It is not a migration-complete claim or agent sign-off. PR #3 remains untouched, and no source repository or branch is deleted.

title: Review source omissions and preserved legacy contributions
body:
## Review only — not a migration sign-off

Base candidate: `4072851ad13536b3e65cbd7fecfe73d306038d32`. This branch contains 130 additions. It preserves 119 byte-unique source files under `archives/migration-review/` and adds the omission/verification inventories under `docs/migration-review/`. It does not modify or replace candidate application files.

The README documents the hash comparison, unresolved media and original-archive disposition, protected private/runtime exclusions, and agent sign-off gate. The raw media themselves are inventoried, not uploaded. No source repositories are approved for deletion by this PR.

Remote verification: every added file's Git blob hash matches the local review bundle; the candidate-to-branch diff is exactly 130 added paths with no modifications or deletions. No application build or runtime verification is claimed.

Please review the README and report source-specific omissions/disposition in [shared issue #1](https://github.com/vitalitychems-dot/Grok-ready/issues/1).
